summary: The labels print conjugated linoleic acid or CLA at 500 mg to 4000 mg a serving; 4 print Clarinol and 5 print Tonalin. Pooled trials show small statistically significant changes (37671495, 17490954, 21990002), but the high-quality subgroup shows no fat-mass change (37671495), and the long-term review says the evidence does not convincingly show a clinically relevant effect (21990002). One 8-week crossover of Clarinol G-80 at 3.5 g/day was null (21593349). No abstract read names Tonalin as a tested material. Exercise performance is null in pooled data (36048508) and one trial (26003683). Abstracts only.
